excerpt.en: These nomadic spiritualists traverse a deified route dictated by their ancestral scriptures. With technological advancements and an evolving understanding of the galaxy, will the Pilgrimage remain their purpose?

uncertain: Option-level conditions of 2120/2125 were read through the compiled tree only.

label.en: The beginning of the Sacred Path

label.en: The seven sacred sites

note.zh: 2050（显化之地）完成后七个项目同时开放（眼、修道院、摇篮、智慧体、安息宝库、鸿沟、镜子），可按任意顺序完成；每个遗址完成后30–60天尝试触发2100，只有七个旗标齐备且尚未完成时才会出现。
note.en: After Emergence (2050) all seven projects open at once and can be finished in any order. Each site tries to fire 2100 30-60 days later, which only appears once all seven flags are set and the path is not yet complete (events/nomads_origin_events.txt:1313-1377).

label.en: The Intelligence's result

note.en: Random, 50% each (events/nomads_origin_events.txt:827-830).

label.en: Responses to Divided Faith

note.en: Chosen by the options of 2015 (pilgrims / devout / faithful), 1800 days later (events/nomads_origin_events.txt:99-184).

label.zh: 圣道的三种收束
label.en: The three conclusions of the Sacred Path

note.zh: 由2115与2120/2125的选择决定：欢乐启蒙、中庸之道或接纳混乱。
note.en: Decided by the choices at 2115 and 2120/2125: Joyous Enlightenment, The Middle Path or Embracing the Chaos.

texts.zh: 这些游牧的唯心主义者遵循其祖先圣典的指引，穿梭于一条神圣化的路线。随着技术的进步以及对星系理解的演变，朝圣之旅是否仍将是他们的使命所在？
texts.en: These nomadic spiritualists traverse a deified route dictated by their ancestral scriptures. With technological advancements and an evolving understanding of the galaxy, will the Pilgrimage remain their purpose?

sections.zh:
千百年来，我们一直在星际间漫游。以相对论速度穿越星海，在每个神圣遗址之间跨过一个个纪元。

在超光速引擎的祝佑下，我们的人民现在有机会实现祖先们的梦想：在有生之年寻遍我们所有神圣遗址。

在领袖[GetRulerTitle][GetRulerName]的英明领导下，既然我们现在有能力如此迅速地穿越这条路径，信众们已准备好去探索这一切对我们信仰的意义。

从我们的祖先那里流传下来的古老星图，标记着星辰中的路标。现在我们前往那些神圣的奇迹朝圣，向那些先辈致敬，从他们的角度认识整个星系。这是我们的天赋权利。这是我们的神圣之路。
sections.en:
For millennia, we have wandered among the stars. Traversing the astral sea at relativistic speed, crossing eons between each Sacred Site.

With the blessing of the hyperdrive, our people now have the chance to do what our ancestors could only have dreamed: visit all our holy sites in a single lifetime.

Under the wise leadership of [GetRulerTitle] [GetRulerName], the congregation is ready to find out what it means for our Faith, now that we can traverse the path so quickly?

The ancient maps, passed down from our ancestors, mark waypoints in the stars. Now we make our pilgrimage to those sanctified wonders, to pay homage to those who came before us, and understand the galaxy from their perspective. This is our birthright. This is our Sacred Path.

label.zh: 圣道的起点
label.en: The beginning of the Sacred Path

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现统治者的名字。
note.en: In the game, the ruler's name appears here.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现统治者的称号。
note.en: In the game, the ruler's title appears here.

texts.zh:
有一个地方被称为显化之地。对我们的祖先来说，它标志着圣路的开端。在履行我们自己设想的朝圣之旅前，这是一个适合冥想参悟我们上古文献的地方。通过现在花些时间进行研究，我们可以更好地规划未来的旅程。

之后，我们将规划前往已知的圣地的路线。一路上我们将面临许多选择。但是，理论上，如果我们相信神灵和我们的祖先，真正的道路就会向我们显现。
texts.en:
There is a place called Emergence. For our ancestors, it marked the beginning of the Sacred Path. It is a fitting place to meditate on our ancient texts before proceeding with our own version of the Pilgrimage. By taking some time to research now, we can better plan for the journey ahead.

Afterward, we will chart a course to the known Sacred Sites. We will have many choices to make along the way. But in theory, if we trust in the deities and our ancestors, the true Path will be revealed to us.

label.zh: 我们将原原本本地遵循“先辈之道”。
label.en: We follow the Path of the Ancestors.

label.zh: 我们将是自己道路的规划者。
label.en: We can be masters of our own Path.

texts.zh:
神圣遗址在祖先星图上皆有标注；它们是星系的奇观，由我们一族的先行者所发现。

探寻这些地方，并查明它们为何对我们的祖先如此重要，是我们的生来享有的权利。

随着我们开拓前进的道路，我们或许可以在拥有神圣遗址的星系中建立驿站。
texts.en:
The Sacred Sites are marked in the ancestral star charts; wonders of the galaxy, discovered by those who came before us.

It is our birthright to seek out these places, and find out why they were so important to our ancestors.

As we forge our path, it may be possible for us to build Waystations in systems with Sacred Sites.

texts.zh:
祖传文献记载，在此坐标发生了一件至关重要的事情。他们称之为“显化之地”，据说这里是他们启动仪式以祈求神灵降临的地方。据说那是一个奇迹之地。初步扫描显示存在大幅磁偏转。

岁月流逝，此处已面目全非，但我们仍应前往调查，以探究显化之地所蕴含的精神意义。
texts.en:
The ancestral writings describe a crucial event that occurred at these coordinates. Known to them as Emergence, this was where they initiated a ritual to invoke the deities. It was said to be a place of wonder. Initial scans indicate substantial magnetic deviation.

Time has rendered it much changed, but we should investigate regardless, for Emergence's spiritual significance.

texts.zh:
在调查显化之地后，[Root.Owner.GetRulerTitle][Root.Owner.GetRulerName]突然陷入类紧张精神症状。医疗官被召至[Root.Owner.Ruler.GetHerHis]位于[Owner.Capital.GetName]的住处，但当他们到达时，[Root.Owner.Ruler.GetSheHe]已经恢复了正常。

[Root.Owner.GetRulerTitle]声称[Root.Owner.Ruler.GetHerHis]在恍惚中与神祇进行了交流，神祇赐福了我们朝圣的开始。

今天是我们的显圣日。
texts.en:
After surveying Emergence, [Root.Owner.GetRulerTitle] [Root.Owner.GetRulerName] suddenly became catatonic. Medical officers were called to [Root.Owner.Ruler.GetHerHis] quarters aboard [Owner.Capital.GetName], but upon arrival, [Root.Owner.Ruler.GetSheHe] had recovered.

In [Root.Owner.Ruler.GetHerHis] trance, the [Root.Owner.GetRulerTitle] claims to have communed with the deities, who have blessed the beginning of our pilgrimage.

This is our Emergence Day.

label.zh: 我们的道路已被祝圣！
label.en: Our path is blessed!

tooltips.zh: 众神将指引我们，正如他们曾指引我们的祖先。
tooltips.en: The Deities will guide us, as they did our Ancestors.

label.zh: 完成医疗评估，以防万一。
label.en: Complete the medical assessment, just in case.

tooltips.zh: 保持适度的怀疑态度并非亵渎。
tooltips.en: Some healthy skepticism is hardly blasphemy.

note.en: In the game, this Arkship's name appears here.

note.en: The game picks the pronoun that fits this character.

texts.zh: 用我们祖先的话来说，在[this.GetName]的国境范围内有一只“不眠之眼”。我们理解这应该是指一座轨道天文台。
texts.en: In the words of our ancestors, there is an 'Unsleeping Eye' within [this.GetName]'s grasp. We understand this to be a reference to an orbital observatory.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现这颗圣地星球的名称。
note.en: In the game, this sacred planet's name appears here.

texts.zh:
这里是先人们很久以前标记过的地点之一。一座围绕[fromfrom.GetName]轨道运行的古老天文台，其望远镜固定在一个遥远的目标上。

文献记载，一些凝视镜头的朝圣者看到了改变生命的景象。据说还有一些人哭泣，或沉默了几天。

这个所谓的“眼睛”已经凝视深渊2000多年了。我们无从得知祖先观察的真实对象。
texts.en:
This is one of the sites the Ancestors marked long ago. An ancient observatory in orbit of [fromfrom.GetName], its telescope fixed on a distant subject.

The texts claim some Pilgrims who gazed through the lens were met with life-changing visions. Others are said to have wept, or fallen silent for days.

The so-called Eye has been staring into the abyss for over 2,000 years. We have no way of knowing the true object of our ancestors' observations.

label.zh: 不管怎样，我们还是看看吧。也许能找到线索。
label.en: Let's take a look anyway. We may find a clue.

label.zh: 关闭天文台。让过去安息。
label.en: Decommission the observatory. Let the past rest.

label.zh: 所以它就是一台没有主人的大望远镜？
label.en: So it's a powerful telescope with no owner?

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现这颗星球的名称。
note.en: In the game, this planet's name appears here.

texts.zh:
透过望远镜，[owner.GetScientistCapital][sacred_eye_scientist.GetName]观察着虚空。这片空间中没有星星。没有光，什么都没有。难道这里曾经有过值得观察的东西吗？我们的祖先是否曾经仰望过一颗已经不复存在的星星？我们可能永远无法得知。

我们所知道的只是，没有什么是一成不变的，万物皆在变化。这就是生命的意义。总有一天，我们自己的光芒会停止闪耀，取而代之的将是别的东西……或者什么都没有。我们此刻能身在此处，本身就是一种喜悦的源泉。或许这就是“圣眼”的最终教诲。
texts.en:
Peering through the telescope, [owner.GetScientistCapital] [sacred_eye_scientist.GetName] observed the void. There are no stars in this patch of space. No light, nothing. Could it be that there was once something to observe here? Did our ancestors look upon a star that no longer exists? We may never know.

All we do know is that nothing is fixed, and everything changes. This is what it means to be alive. One day our own light will stop shining, and be replaced by something else... or nothing. That we are here now, in this moment, is a source of joy. Perhaps this is the Eye's ultimate lesson.

label.zh: 无常让我们变得特别。
label.en: Impermanence is what makes us special.

label.zh: 并非万事万物都有意义。
label.en: Not everything needs to mean something.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现首席科学官的名字。
note.en: In the game, the head scientist's name appears here.

texts.zh:
不再有神圣遗址可供探索。

先祖星图引导我们跨越了遥远的距离，如今我们终于追上了过去。但问题依然存在：我们发现的是真相吗？还是说，我们一直以来追随的不过是一场谎言？

这条道路始终是我们文化中不可或缺的一部分。它是先祖所命定的。但在目睹了他们当年的所见，并拥有了现代科学的优势后，那些经文是否依然真实？亦或是，我们的社会注定要踏上一条全新的、不再那么虔诚的道路？
texts.en:
There are no more Sacred Sites left to explore.

The Ancestral Star Charts guided us across vast distances, and now we have caught up with our past. But the question remains: was it truth we found? Or have we been following a lie?

The Path has always been an integral part of our culture. It was ordained by our ancestors. But having seen what they saw, and with the privilege of modern science, do the texts still ring true? Or is our society destined to follow a new, less pious Path?

label.zh: 我们决不能改变航向。保持忠信！
label.en: We must not alter course. Remain faithful!

label.zh: 现在当然由我们自己选择成为什么样。
label.en: Surely we get to choose who we are now.

label.zh: 一切都不明朗。我们已经迷失了道路。
label.en: It is unclear. We have lost our way.

notes.zh: 七处圣地全部完成后的汇总事件；之后300天出现2105，再过1800天出现2115。
notes.en: The summary event once all seven sites are done; 2105 follows 300 days later, then 2115 after another 1800 days.

texts.zh: 总会有人心怀不轨；他们想让我们的历史被遗忘，让我们的传统随时间流逝。我们绝不能让他们分裂我们。我们必须保护我们传统的生活方式。如果我们听从神灵的指引，祂们便会继续指引我们，但我们必须对祂们的影响敞开心扉。
texts.en: There will always be those with an agenda; those that would see our history be ignored, and our conventions lost to time. We cannot let them divide us. We must protect our traditional way of life. The deities will continue to guide us if we just let them, but we have to remain open to their influence.

label.zh: 这就是我们。
label.en: This is who we are.

label.zh: 我们的祖先肯定允许变革。
label.en: Surely our ancestors allowed for change.

texts.zh:
我们社会核心的分歧正在加深。进步人士被迫接受改变，而传统主义者则害怕任何不同的事物。

此时我们必须自问：我们的民族能否再次团结起来，和谐共处？否则后果可能不堪设想。

每个人都应该有自由以自己的方式实践自己的信仰，但如果我们的派系斗争导致内战，那么我们必须绝对确信自己的信念。
texts.en:
The rift at the heart of our society is deepening. Progressives are compelled to embrace change, while traditionalists fear anything that is different.

At this point we have to ask ourselves: is there any way we can come together again as a people, and live in harmony? The alternative could be devastating.

Everyone should have the freedom to practice their faith in their own way, but if our factionalism leads us to civil war then we must be absolutely certain of our convictions.

label.zh: 我们必须促进理解。
label.en: We must foster understanding.

tooltips.zh: 这可能会鼓励我们的民众接纳更加平等主义的思潮。
tooltips.en: This may encourage more egalitarian ethics in our population.

label.zh: 共存绝无可能！
label.en: Coexistence is impossible!

tooltips.zh: 这可能会鼓励我们的民众接纳更加威权主义的思潮。
tooltips.en: This may encourage more authoritarian ethics in our population.

texts.zh:
没有过去，我们便一无所有。没有“大道”，我们便无处可去。有时，对我们信仰的挑战正是我们所需要的，它能激励我们，提醒我们，当我们放弃自己的道路时，将会面临怎样的危险。

我们正从一段内忧外患的黑暗时期中走出来。我们曾几乎为了自己的信念而自相残杀，而实际上，唯一能拯救我们所有人的，正是团结。

让我们永远不要再彼此反目。我们必须完全致力于同一种“大道”。
texts.en:
Without the past, we are nothing. Without the Path, we have nowhere to go. Sometimes a challenge to our beliefs is what we need to galvanize us, and remind us of what is at stake when we forsake our ways.

We are emerging from a dark period of inner turmoil. We were almost willing to tear ourselves apart for our convictions, when in reality the only thing that can save us all is unity.

Let us never turn against one another again. We must be committed fully to the same Path.

label.zh: 我们将全力以赴！
label.en: We commit ourselves completely!

label.zh: 必须只有平衡。
label.en: There must only be balance.

texts.zh:
我们带着信念和希望追随此“大道”，并已得道。

现在，我们明白重新圣化所有已知圣地，并扩展此道以造福无数物种和文明，是我们的神圣职责。

我们的仁慈将传播到星辰之间，与所有愿意的灵魂相连。
texts.en:
We have followed the Path, in faith and hope, and we have attained enlightenment.

Now, we see it is our holy duty to re-sanctify all known sacred sites, and expand the path so that it may bless countless species and civilizations.

Our benevolence will spread across the stars and connect with all willing souls.

label.zh: 无上欢愉！
label.en: Jubilations!

label.zh: 欢乐启蒙
label.en: Joyous Enlightenment

note.zh: 设置旗标并触发时间线事件。
note.en: Sets a flag and fires a timeline event.

texts.zh:
这从来都不关乎“道路”本身。最重要的是我们共同度过的旅程。我们的族人遵循这一传统已有数百年之久，然而在任何历史文献中，我们都从未发现过这条道路真正的“目的”。它或许早已淹没在时间的长河里。

我们会铭记先辈流传下来的故事，以及他们曾进行的朝圣之旅，但我们不再需要追随他们的脚步。比起他们，我们对生命、银河系以及自身都有了更深刻的认知。他们所坚持的真理已不再适用于我们。我们将开辟属于自己的道路。
texts.en:
It was never about the Path itself. What's most important is the journey we make together. Our people have followed this tradition for centuries, and yet we have never found, in any of our historical documents, the true 'purpose' of the Path. It may be lost to time.

We will remember the surviving stories of our ancestors, and the Pilgrimage they made, but we no longer need to follow their lead. We know more about life, the galaxy, and ourselves than they did. The truths they held are no longer relevant to us. We will chart our own path.

label.zh: 大道至简，本性具足。
label.en: The Path was within us all along.

label.zh: 中庸之道
label.en: The Middle Path

note.zh: 设置旗标并触发时间线事件。
note.en: Sets a flag and fires a timeline event.

texts.zh:
过去拖累我们、阻碍我们进化。从历史中吸取教训是一回事，但停滞不前，永远无法超越历史，则是愚蠢的。

我们不必浪费自我发现的潜力。既然我们已经摆脱了昨日的枷锁，我们就可以以奔放的热情向前迈进。

我们不再受制于技术落后的祖先。众神留下的神秘碎片也不再能决定我们的道路。我们选择自己的“大道”，没有任何事物能阻挡我们。
texts.en:
The past pulls us back, keeping us from evolving. Learning from history is one thing, but remaining there, never moving beyond it, is foolish.

We need not waste our potential for self-discovery. Now that we have shrugged off the chains of yesterday, we can move forward with unbridled passion.

No longer will we be governed by our technologically inferior ancestors. No longer will the Path be dictated by the cryptic crumbs laid by the deities. We choose our own Path, and nothing can stand in our way.

label.zh: 这条“大道”使我们感到清晰。
label.en: The Path brings us clarity.

label.zh: 唯一的真理就是战争之路……
label.en: The only true Path is a war path...

texts.zh:
现在一切都清晰了。我们祖先的神圣遗址是病态甜美的希望和信仰灯塔。那些先我们而来的人毫无羞耻之心，也不在乎别人是否知道。

我们的声誉已被轻视和玷污。我们有能力圣化新的地点，以传达我们更新后的精神使命。

神灵是复杂且被误解的。通过这条“大道”，祂们教导我们冲突是我们社会的自然特征。我们克服的挑战使我们变得更强大。现在我们将向整个星系展示我们的力量！
texts.en:
Everything is clearer now. The Sacred Sites of our ancestors are sickly sweet beacons of hope and faith. Those who came before us had no shame, and they didn't care who knew it.

Our reputation has been trivialized and tarnished. We have it in our power to sanctify new sites that will communicate our updated spiritual mission.

The deities are complex and misunderstood. Through the Path, they have taught us that conflict is a natural feature of our society. The challenges we overcome make us stronger. Now we will demonstrate our strength across the galaxy!

label.zh: 这就是我们的圣战。
label.en: This is our crusade.

label.zh: 接纳混乱
label.en: Embracing the Chaos

note.zh: 设置旗标并触发时间线事件。
note.en: Sets a flag and fires a timeline event.

texts.zh: 根据我们的圣典记载，[this.GetName]曾是一座古老修道院的所在地。
texts.en: According to our sacred texts, [this.GetName] was once the location of an ancient monastery.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现这颗圣地星球的名称。
note.en: In the game, this sacred planet's name appears here.

texts.zh:
朝圣者聚集在天文台里。耳语传开——这里是我们的祖先所描述的地方之一：[fromfrom.GetName]修道院。然而，回廊内空无一人。除了石头与尘土，这里一无所有。

各甲板相继传来报告，称通讯系统中回荡着神秘的吟唱声。部分船员推测，这些声音可能属于我们的先祖，他们正以非物质形态栖息在这片星域，并用神明的语言吟唱。
texts.en:
Pilgrims gather in the observation decks. Whispers spread: this is one of the places described by our ancestors: The Monastery of [fromfrom.GetName]. But the cloister is empty. There is nothing here but stone and dust.

Reports are coming in from all decks about a mysterious chanting, echoing through our comms system. There is speculation from some crew members that the voices may belong to our ancestors, inhabiting this area of space in non-corporeal form, and chanting in the language of the gods.

label.zh: 诵经是一种赐福。接纳它吧。
label.en: The chanting is a blessing. Embrace it.

label.zh: 不太可能。我们的通讯设备需要维护。
label.en: Unlikely. Our comms require maintenance.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现这颗星球的名称。
note.en: In the game, this planet's name appears here.

texts.zh: 我们的祖先高度重视[this.GetName]。如果我们正确理解了这些文本，一些非常重要的事情正在这里等待着我们。
texts.en: Our ancestors held [this.GetName] in high regard. If we have understood the texts correctly, something very important awaits us here.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现这颗圣地星球的名称。
note.en: In the game, this sacred planet's name appears here.

texts.zh:
我们的旅程将我们带到了这里：一个只在传世故事和神圣歌谣中才被提及的地方。文本中记载着一种存在，栖息于这颗星球的核心。起初我们并未察觉，但随着我们逐渐靠近，记忆浮现了出来。

摇篮

尽管关于摇篮在塑造我们文化方面的作用众说纷纭，但所有人都能认同，它是我们信仰的圣化渠道。

然而，抵达后我们没有发现古老的庙宇。没有被神化的纪念碑。在这个星球上，也找不到任何神圣活动的痕迹。[root.GetName]号上的朝圣者们现在都在期待[Root.Owner.GetRulerTitle] [Root.Owner.GetRulerName]给出答案。他们迫切想知道：这究竟是对信仰的考验？还是说摇篮的力量不过是个传说？
texts.en:
Our journey brings us here: a place remembered only in traditional stories and devotional songs. The texts speak of a presence that inhabits the core of this world. We did not recognize it at first, but as we drew nearer, the memories surfaced.

The Cradle

While there are differing opinions regarding the Cradle's role in shaping our culture, all can agree that it is a sanctified conduit of our faith.

However, upon arrival, we found no ancient temples. No deified monuments. No trace of godly activity, anywhere on the planet. The Pilgrims aboard [root.GetName] now look to [Root.Owner.GetRulerTitle] [Root.Owner.GetRulerName] for answers. They beg to know: is this a test of faith? Or is the Cradle's power nothing more than a story?

label.zh: 我们必须用谎言维持这个传说。
label.en: We must lie to maintain the legend.

label.zh: 我们首要的职责是忠于真相。
label.en: Our first duty is to the truth.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现统治者的名字。
note.en: In the game, the ruler's name appears here.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现统治者的称号。
note.en: In the game, the ruler's title appears here.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现这艘舰船的名称。
note.en: In the game, the ship's name appears here.

texts.zh:
我们检测到源自这些坐标的人工信号。奇怪的是，这里据说是我们其中一个神圣遗址。信号包含一段编码信息，我们已将其转录并翻译成语言。

“崇拜已启用。和平现在可以开始。”
texts.en:
We have detected an artificial signal originating from these coordinates. Curiously, this is where one of our Sacred Sites is purported to be. The signal contains a coded message which we have transcribed and translated to language.

"WORSHIP IS ENABLED. PEACE MAY NOW COMMENCE."

texts.zh:
在[fromfrom.GetName]的轨道上漂浮着一座我们的祖先曾在星图上标注过的结构。在它寂静的舱室里，我们发现了一个指引者的存在：一个古老的智能体，其使命是为终将踏上这条道路的人们指点迷津。

岁月虽不留情，但它的声音依然回响。破碎的指令从隐藏的发射器中溢出，语调半带模糊却又充满虔敬：“沿着光之线继续前行……星际间的黑暗正变得稀薄……”

它的信息支离破碎，与更古老的诗篇循环碰撞。然而，在噪音与衰朽之下，那份意志依然存在。它本是为了指引我们而生。或许，只要我们细心聆听，它依然能做到。
texts.en:
Orbiting [fromfrom.GetName] drifts a structure our ancestors once marked upon their star charts. Within its quiet chambers, we discovered a guiding presence: an ancient Intelligence, tasked with answering the questions of those who would one day walk this path.

Time has not been kind, but its voice still stirs. Fragments of instruction spill from hidden emitters, half-coherent and reverent in tone: "Continue along the luminous thread... The dark between stars grows thin..."

Its messages arrive in splinters, looping and colliding with older verses. Yet beneath the static and decay, there remains intention. It was meant to guide us. And perhaps, if we listen with care, it still can.

label.zh: 赞美科技先知！
label.en: Praise be to the techno-prophet!

label.zh: 清除这个腐败的怪物。
label.en: Purge this corrupted monstrosity.

tooltips.zh: 这可能会鼓励我们的民众接纳更加威权主义的思潮。
tooltips.en: This may encourage more authoritarian ethics in our population.

label.zh: 把它带上来。先辈们是睿智的。
label.en: Bring it aboard. The ancestors were wise.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现这颗星球的名称。
note.en: In the game, this planet's name appears here.

texts.zh:
我们得到了智能体的祝福，平安无事地离开了[fromfromfrom.GetName]。

智能体将留在那里，作为我们祖先卓越工程的证明，也是神通过他们运作的证据。

我们被它的仁慈所激励，并向其他生命形式敞开了心扉。
texts.en:
We received the Intelligence's blessing, and departed [fromfromfrom.GetName] without incident.

The Intelligence will remain there, a testament to the engineering prowess of our ancestors, and proof of the divine working through them.

We are galvanized by its benevolence, and have opened our minds to alternative forms of life.

label.zh: 我们与万物合一。
label.en: We are one with all beings.

tooltips.zh: 这可能会鼓励我们的民众接纳更加平等主义的思潮。
tooltips.en: This may encourage more egalitarian ethics in our population.

label.zh: 所有的合成生命都是神圣的。
label.en: All synthetic life is sacred.

tooltips.zh: 这可能会鼓励我们的民众接纳更加平等主义的思潮。
tooltips.en: This may encourage more egalitarian ethics in our population.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现这颗星球的名称。
note.en: In the game, this planet's name appears here.

texts.zh:
当我们准备离开[fromfromfrom.GetName]时，智慧体开始发出越来越令人担忧的言论。

"肉-身-是-对-神-明-的-冒-犯！所-有-血-肉-都-必-须-被-舍-弃！物-质-存-在-是-不-洁-的——肉-体-必-须-被-净-化！思-想-必-须-自-由！"

[owner.GetScientistCapital][mechsiah_plug_scientist.GetName]被迫手动关闭了这个人工先知，否则我们恐会被“去肉身化”。目前尚不清楚智慧体在活跃状态下有多强大。我们对其编程知之甚少。
texts.en:
As we prepared to depart [fromfromfrom.GetName], the Intelligence began spouting increasingly alarming rhetoric.

"PHYSICAL FORM IS AN AFRONT TO THE DEITIES! ALL FLESH MUST BE SHED! CORPOREAL EXISTENCE IS UNCLEAN - BODIES MUST BE PURGED! THE MIND MUST BE FREE!"

[owner.GetScientistCapital] [mechsiah_plug_scientist.GetName] was forced to manually shut down the artificial prophet, else we be de-corporealized. It remains unclear how powerful the Intelligence is when active. We understand little of its programming.

label.zh: 最安全的做法是把它炸上天。
label.en: The safest thing would be to blow it up.

label.zh: 把它插头拔了就差不多得了。
label.en: Let's just leave it unplugged.

label.zh: 接入失败。终止这个失控的人工智能体。
label.en: Interfacing failed. Terminate this rogue intelligence.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现这颗星球的名称。
note.en: In the game, this planet's name appears here.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现首席科学官的名字。
note.en: In the game, the head scientist's name appears here.

texts.zh: 据先祖们的记载，[this.GetName]有一颗天然卫星，是追随我们信仰的长者们最终安息之所。
texts.en: According to the Ancestors' logs, [this.GetName] has a natural satellite which serves as a final resting place for elders of our faith.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现这颗圣地星球的名称。
note.en: In the game, this sacred planet's name appears here.

texts.zh:
我们已经对[fromfrom.GetName]调查完毕，这个圣洁的纪念之地。这是一个封闭的密室，早期朝圣者曾用它来记录他们的临终思绪，并将其铭刻在稀有的灵能水晶中。

这个宝库现在已满，回荡着智慧、信仰和喜悦。但在那些记忆中，也保存了数百年的恐惧、憎恨和怀疑。

如果会众成员能够接触到这些临终时刻，这可能会挑战他们对“大道”的信仰。
texts.en:
We have surveyed [fromfrom.GetName], a place of sacred memory. A sealed chamber, once used by early pilgrims to record their final thoughts and commit them to rare psionic crystals.

The vault is now full, echoing with wisdom, faith, and joy. But within those memories, there are also centuries of preserved fear, loathing, and doubt.

If members of the congregation were to gain access to these final moments, it may challenge their faith in the Path.

label.zh: 这些声音应该被世人聆听。
label.en: These voices should be heard.

tooltips.zh: 这可能会鼓励我们的民众接纳更加平等主义的思潮。
tooltips.en: This may encourage more egalitarian ethics in our population.

label.zh: 重新封闭宝库。我们该走了。
label.en: Reseal the vault. We should leave.

tooltips.zh: 这可能会鼓励我们的民众接纳更加威权主义的思潮。
tooltips.en: This may encourage more authoritarian ethics in our population.

label.zh: 让我们把自己的思绪也加入宝库吧。
label.en: Let us add our own thoughts to the vault.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现这颗星球的名称。
note.en: In the game, this planet's name appears here.

texts.zh: [this.GetName]曾令我们的祖先感到恐惧。他们的传说中提到“潜伏在地表以下深坑中”的“危险而强大的野兽”。
texts.en: [this.GetName] was feared by our progenitors. Their legends speak of a "dangerous and powerful beast" that "lurks in a pit below the surface".

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现这颗圣地星球的名称。
note.en: In the game, this sacred planet's name appears here.

texts.zh:
我们的祖先说得没错。[fromfrom.GetName]的表面之下确实存在着一头野兽。我们很幸运它对我们没有威胁，因为它已经死了。这生物的遗骸之巨大令人震惊。它双足行走，有翅膀，浑身覆盖鳞片，眼睛的数量比我们之前见过的任何单个生物都要多得多。它真是个异域之物。

在通往深坑入口附近的一个壁龛里，我们发现了一段刻在洞穴岩石上的信息。用古老的语言写着：

“我们，携带光明的人，驱逐了这可憎之物。这恶心的野兽将永世腐烂。”

我们推测我们的祖先并不是在警告我们关于这头野兽，而是在警告背叛的后果。这生物的尸体仍然是他们愤怒的例证。
texts.en:
Our ancestors spoke true. There is in fact a beast below the surface of [fromfrom.GetName]. We are blessed that it poses no threat to us, for it is deceased. The remains of the creature are staggeringly huge. Bipedal, winged, covered in scales, and with considerably more ocular organs than we've encountered before on a single being. It is truly alien.

In an alcove near the entrance to the pit, we discovered a message carved into the cavernous rock. In the language of the ancients, it says:

"WE, THE LIGHT BRINGERS, CAST OUT THIS ABOMINATION. THE FOUL BEAST WILL ROT IN ETERNITY."

We surmise our ancestors were not warning us of the beast, but of the consequences for betrayal. This creature's body remains an example of their wrath.

label.zh: 激怒祖先从来不是明智之举。
label.en: Angering the progenitors is never wise.

tooltips.zh: 这可能会鼓励我们的民众接纳更加威权主义的思潮。
tooltips.en: This may encourage more authoritarian ethics in our population.

label.zh: 没有生物该承受这样的命运。
label.en: No creature deserves such a fate.

tooltips.zh: 这可能会鼓励我们的民众接纳更加平等主义的思潮。
tooltips.en: This may encourage more egalitarian ethics in our population.

label.zh: 无论它有什么罪过，都值得安息。
label.en: Whatever its sins, it deserves to rest peacefully.

tooltips.zh: 我们会将这头野兽的遗骸运到方舟舰，在那里它将被保存和尊重。
tooltips.en: We will transport the beast's remains to the Arkship where it will be preserved and respected.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现这颗星球的名称。
note.en: In the game, this planet's name appears here.

texts.zh:
此地有一处神圣遗址，其名根据我们祖先的语言大致翻译为镜子。

据说此地天界之间的界限异常稀薄，人们可能会遭遇来自我们宇宙之外的异界生物。
texts.en:
There is a Sacred Site at this location, its name roughly translated from our ancestral language as the Mirror.

It is said that the boundary between celestial planes is thinner here, and one may confront other-worldly entities from beyond our universe.

texts.zh:
我们抵达了坐标，很快就收到了一艘与我们加密协议完全相同的飞船发来的消息。奇怪的是，我们的外部传感器无法探测到另一艘飞船，但传输却异常清晰，仿佛近在咫尺。当舰桥的显示屏亮起时，我们看到的是我们自己的[Root.Owner.GetRulerTitle][Root.Owner.GetRulerName]

我们还没来得及回应，那个冒牌货就开口了：

“不要害怕，[Root.Owner.GetRulerTitle]，你很安全。我以这种形式出现，是出于尊重。你的道路正在变化，你接下来采取的步骤将启动你尚未理解的事物。

“你必须消灭那些不遵循“大道”的异教徒。我们会看着你的。”

图像消失了。我们不知道刚才发生了什么。
texts.en:
We arrived at the coordinates, and were promptly contacted by a ship with identical encryption protocols to our own. Perplexingly, our external sensors could not detect another vessel, but the transmission was clear as if we were in visual range. When the bridge view-screen flickered into action, we were met with the image of our own [Root.Owner.GetRulerTitle] [Root.Owner.GetRulerName].

Before we could respond, the double spoke:

"Be not afraid, [Root.Owner.GetRulerTitle], you are safe. I take this form as a respectful gesture. Your path is in flux, and the steps you take next will set things into motion that you can not yet comprehend.

"You must eliminate heretics who do not follow the Path."

The image vanished. We do not know what just happened.

label.zh: 消息很明确！肃清异教徒！
label.en: The message is clear! Purge the disbelievers!

label.zh: 谎言！我们不会被伪神所操控。
label.en: Lies! We will not be manipulated by false gods.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现统治者的名字。
note.en: In the game, the ruler's name appears here.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现统治者的称号。
note.en: In the game, the ruler's title appears here.

texts.zh:
至高朝圣者、虔敬行家和信仰侍僧。这三个独特的社会群体构成了精神修行者的等级制度。一直以来都是如此。至高朝圣者引领道路，虔敬行家致力于修行，而信仰侍僧则通过崇拜和体力劳动来支持我们的事业。

然而，在方舟舰[Owner.Capital.GetName]上，由于我们自从加速星际旅行以来所承担的角色，分裂正在形成。一些船员认为他们的职责比其他人更重要，现在每个群体都要求被认为是不可或缺的。
texts.en:
High Pilgrims, Devoted Adepts, and Faithful Acolytes. These three distinct social groups form the hierarchy of spiritual practitioners. This is how it has always been. High Pilgrims lead the way, while Devoted Adepts commit themselves to the path, and the Faithful Acolytes support our endeavors through worship and physical toil.

However, schisms are forming aboard the Arkship [Owner.Capital.GetName] due to the roles we have assumed since committing to accelerated interstellar travel. Some crew members believe their responsibilities outweigh those of others, and now each group is demanding to be recognized as the most essential.

label.zh: 至高朝圣者受人尊敬是有原因的。
label.en: High Pilgrims are revered for a reason.

label.zh: 至高朝圣者受人尊敬是有原因的。
label.en: High Pilgrims are revered for a reason.

label.zh: 虔诚圣职理应获得更多认可。
label.en: The Devoted deserve more recognition.

label.zh: 让我们听听信徒的诉求。
label.en: Let's hear it for the Faithful!

label.zh: 每个人的贡献都具有同等价值。
label.en: Everyone's contributions are of equal worth.

label.zh: 劳工合作社
label.en: Worker Cooperative

label.zh: 同甘共苦
label.en: Shared Burdens

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现这艘方舟舰的名称。
note.en: In the game, this Arkship's name appears here.

notes.zh: “分裂的信仰”在2005之后3600天独立出现，与圣地进度无关。
notes.en: Divided Faith comes 3600 days after 2005, independent of the sacred-site progress.

texts.zh:
至高朝圣者们引领我们走向辉煌，继续倡导精神上的满足，致力于我们所有人的福祉。虔诚圣职和信徒追随他们的脚步，怀着敬意和崇敬仰望着他们。

作为我们信仰的最高典范，至高朝圣者们也享有某些船上特权。他们拥有更宽敞的住处，可以使用更多资源，并在所有甲板上享有优先通行权。
texts.en:
Steering us to glory, the High Pilgrims continue to champion spiritual fulfillment, dedicating their lives to the betterment of all of us. The Devoted and the Faithful follow in their steps, looking up to them with respect and reverence.

Representing the highest ideal of our faith, the High Pilgrims are also entitled to certain onboard perks. They have more spacious living quarters, access to more resources, and priority clearance on all decks.

label.zh: 信仰有其特权。一切都是理所当然的。
label.en: Faith has its privileges. All is well.

label.zh: 让我们优先保障公平。
label.en: Let us prioritize fairness.

label.zh: 威权主义
label.en: Authoritarian

texts.zh:
虔敬行家身兼精英与凡人两重身份。他们作为忠实的信徒开始其神职生涯，并渴望成为至高朝圣者，是船上人员的完美缩影。

正因为这些原因，我们强调对至高朝圣者的尊重。他们告知忠实的信徒其潜力所在，并提醒至高朝圣者其出身。他们让我们保持谦逊，并维系着所有甲板之间的联系。

以一次仪式性祝福来表彰虔诚圣职将是表达社会感激之情的好方法。这甚至可能激励他们更加努力地投入到其修行中。
texts.en:
The Devoted Adepts straddle the worlds of the elite and the layperson. Beginning their clerical career as Faithful adherents to our ways, and aspiring to High Pilgrim-hood, they represent a perfect cross section of the ship's company.

It is for these reasons that we emphasize our respect for the Devoted. They inform the Faithful of their potential, and they remind the High Pilgrims where they came from. They keep us humble, and connected across all decks.

Honoring the Devoted with a ceremonial blessing would be a good way to convey societal gratitude. It may even inspire them to devote themselves even harder to their practice.

label.zh: 保佑虔诚圣职。他们让我们的文化熠熠生辉。
label.en: Bless the Devoted. They honor us.

label.zh: 每个人的贡献都具有同等价值。
label.en: Everyone's contributions are of equal worth.

label.zh: 威权主义
label.en: Authoritarian

texts.zh:
信仰侍僧是我们的压舱石。他们是农民、技术员和矿工。他们也是明天的虔诚圣职和至高朝圣者！

我们如此敬重信徒，因为他们支撑起了上层甲板。没有他们，我们的社会就会搁浅。
texts.en:
The Faithful Acolytes are our ballast. They are the farmers, the technicians, and the miners. They are also the Devoted and the High Pilgrims of tomorrow!

We hold the Faithful in such high regard because they stop the deckheads from falling down. Without them, our society would run aground.

label.zh: 他们确实是我们的命脉。赞美他们。
label.en: Indeed, they are our lifeblood. Praise them.

label.zh: 我们社会的每个阶层都必须做出贡献。
label.en: Every stratum of our society must contribute.

label.zh: 威权主义
label.en: Authoritarian

summary.text:
# 神圣之路 / The Sacred Path

- 分类 Category：起源 Origins · DLC：Nomads · 审阅 Reviewed 2026-10-13
- 来源 Sources：`events/nomads_origin_events.txt:1-1652`、`common/special_projects`、`common/event_chains`

> 本导读是审阅者的说明文字，不是游戏原文。 This guide is reviewer commentary, not game text.

## 如何开始 How it starts

开局隐藏事件 nomads.2000 在 5 天后触发 2005“先祖星图”：启用项目“神圣遗址：显化之地”，同时安排 3600 天后的 2015“分裂的信仰”。
At game start hidden nomads.2000 fires 2005 *The Ancestral Star Charts* after 5 days: it enables the Emergence project and schedules 2015 *Divided Faith* 3600 days later.

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

1. **圣地**：显化之地（2050）完成后，七个项目同时开放：不眠之眼（2055 → 2056）、修道院（2060）、摇篮（2065）、智慧体（2070 → 2071 / 2072）、安息宝库（2075）、鸿沟（2080）、镜子（2085），顺序任意。
   **Sacred sites**: after Emergence (2050) seven projects open at once, in any order.
2. **终章**：七处全部完成后 2100“制定下一段航线”→ 300 天后 2105 → 1800 天后 2115 → 2120 / 2125 → 2130 欢乐启蒙 / 2135 中庸之道 / 2140 接纳混乱。
   **Endgame**: when all seven are done 2100 -> 2105 -> 2115 -> 2120 / 2125 -> 2130 / 2135 / 2140.
3. **分裂的信仰**（独立）：2015 的选项 → 1800 天后 2020 / 2025 / 2030。
   **Divided Faith** (independent): the options of 2015 lead 1800 days later to 2020 / 2025 / 2030.

## 分支与结局 Branches and outcomes

- 智慧体 2071 / 2072 各 50%。 2071 / 2072: 50% each.
- 三种收束互斥：2130 / 2135 / 2140。 Three exclusive conclusions.
